mapping.summary: Prints one check stub plus a remittance advice report when a payment covers many invoices
claims: Avoids voided checks when more than 10 invoices are applied to one payment
Prints a single check stub that refers to a separate remittance advice report
Remittance report lists applied invoices with amounts and dates, optionally currency and discounts
Remittance advice can be printed in batch for one or all vendors
Check and remittance layouts can be adapted
Detects multi-invoice payments automatically and switches format
Runs as a native BC extension in the payment posting process
One-time price of 399 USD including setup of one check format
